ip prefix-list PL_TENANT1 seq 5 permit 10.10.0.0/16 le 24
ip prefix-list PL_TENANT1 seq 10 deny 0.0.0.0/0 le 32
ip prefix-list PL_VLAN100 seq 5 permit 10.10.100.0/24
route-map RM_CONN permit 10
  match ip address prefix-list PL_TENANT1
route-map RM_FW_OUT deny 10
  match ip address prefix-list PL_VLAN100
route-map RM_FW_OUT permit 20
route-map RM_COMM permit 10
  match community CL_A
